{{Quote|She said her husband has settled on the estuary moon of Trask in the system of the gas giant Kol Iben.|[[Peli Motto]], to [[Din Djarin]] on "[[Frog Lady]]"|<ref name="Chapter 10" />}}
'''Kol Iben''' was a [[gas giant]] located in a [[Kol Iben system|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Arkanis sector]]. It had at least one [[moon]], the [[Water|estuary]] moon of [[Trask]]. The planet was situated in the [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Chapter 10" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kol Iben was first mentioned in "[[Chapter 10: The Passenger]]," a [[The Mandalorian Season Two|second season]] episode of [[Jon Favreau]]'s live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Peyton Reed]]<ref name="Chapter 10" /> and released on [[November 6]], [[2020]] on [[Disney+]].<ref name="Chapter 10 date">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-november-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in November 2020}}</ref> It debuted in the following episode, "[[Chapter 11: The Heiress]]."<ref name="Chapter 11">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 11: The Heiress}}</ref>
